tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru uṣṇi ṣa dzwa lā ya/ grangs med rgyal kun rig sngags sku/ /khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /gong gi rjes gnang bshad par bya/ /dben pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar/ /tshom bu zlum gtor rgyan ldan dang / /chu gnyis nyer mchod bkod mdzes dang / /rdor dril me tog maṇḍal sogs/ /mthong brgyud lag len spyi ltar bshams/ /mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems sogs/ / khro bo'i dbang po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sbyar/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam ji bzhin no/ /de nas rang skad cig gis gtsug tor 'bar bar gsal bar snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas gtsug tor 'bar ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥ.uṣṇī ṣa dzwa lā ya/ oṃ uṣṇi ṣa dzwa la arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyun bshags dang / tshad med bzhi spyi 'gre/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa la sogs pa sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar bas gdon bgegs rdul du rlog pa/ g.yon khro bo'i sdigs mdzub kyi rtse mor gnam lcags me 'bar gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor bas nyon mongs bdud dpung bsreg par byed pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bsgrad cing / me stag 'phro ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing / ljags 'dril ba/ 'byung po'i khrag gis myos pa'i hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro sgrog pa/

dbu skra dang sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ sbom thung yan lag rags shing gsus khyim che ba'i sku la rin po che dang / klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas gtsug tor 'bar ba la sogs gong bzhin spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstims/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sogs gong bzhin la/ tshur 'dus te hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ/ a pra te ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hī khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzwa la dzwa la/ pra dzwa la pra dzwa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha sha ti sarba dur ni mirti dur swa bhā shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan gyi bar gong bzhin la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ uṣṇi ṣa dzwa la sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ 'jigs dus bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug stong ldir ba'i nga ro'i dbyangs/ /bde stong rnam par mi rtog ye shes dngos/ /khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin gyi mthar/

khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa byas nas/ slob ma la/ sems bskyed sngon 'gro'i maṇḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung dam bca'/ thugs rigs 'dra bstim pa/ gtso bos/ maṇḍal/ deng nas/ rjes chog rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /'di yang las dang po pa la phan pa'i bsam pas sa skya pa kun blos bkod pa maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
